name: Fake_News_Detection
description: AI-powered fake news classifier comparing TF-IDF baselines (Logistic Regression, KNN, Random Forest, MLP) against a fine-tuned DistilBERT transformer, with LIME explainability and an interactive Streamlit dashboard

paragraphs: An advanced Machine Learning and Natural Language Processing (NLP) project that classifies news claims and articles as Real (Reliable) or Fake (Unreliable). This project establishes baseline TF-IDF + traditional classifiers (Logistic Regression, KNN, Random Forest, Neural Network/MLP), fine-tunes a DistilBERT sequence classification Transformer, integrates local Explainable AI (LIME) word-level attributions, and provides an interactive Streamlit capstone dashboard.
